edition: PS5 · base-game list · source recheck 2026-11-20 WIB
policy: Names, descriptions and grades follow the kit. Its starter omits individual hidden flags despite the rules describing them; the 28 flags are corroborated by Output Lag's explicit list [19] and GTABase [33]. Guidance is original source synthesis, not personal gameplay verification. Only a step's own evidence is displayed. Source differences include separate targets, incomplete coverage and unresolved labels; they are not all conflicting unlock methods. A potential missable is a precaution, not a confirmed lockout. Dates use WIB. Previously read pages that failed this recheck retain their earlier date.

disagree.note: Track the two thresholds separately: 50 for this award, 70 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Escape both pursuit and the wider heat area together.
trophies.risk: Repeatable partner attempt; no permanent missable condition reported.

steps.text: Call your partner into free roam after the Chapter 2 partner unlock.
Reach a four-star Wanted Level together; a large vault job provides one automatically.
Lose the active police pursuit with your partner still present.
Leave the wider red heat area too; losing the flashing search area alone is insufficient.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Keep the partner and active stars for all three shops.
trophies.risk: Clearing the Wanted Level breaks this attempt, not the whole run.

steps.text: Call your partner and choose three nearby shops before starting.
Rob the first shop with your partner present.
Rob the second and third shops without clearing the active Wanted Level between stops.
Allow about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop for the source-reported delayed award.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK.
trophies.risk: Free-roam discovery; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Scan passing vehicles with WAiNK; driving each one is unnecessary.
Check Progress > Vehicles for category totals.
Discover 100 distinct vehicles for this trophy.
Continue toward 200 base-model discoveries for 100%, including boats and aircraft.

disagree.topic: Vehicle targets: 100 for this trophy, 200 base models for 100%

versions.text: The trophy asks for 100 discovered vehicles.
The checklist asks for 200 base-model discoveries.

disagree.note: 100 discoveries is this trophy's threshold; 200 base models is the separate 100% requirement.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five gang enemies in one Focus activation.
trophies.risk: Repeatable combat attempt; soldiers, police and civilians are not reported to count.

steps.text: Prepare a full Focus bar; Adrenaline can extend the slow-motion window.
Choose a group of gang-operation enemies, not police, soldiers or civilians.
Aim a firearm and activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3.
Take down five enemies before that single activation ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a gate-docked passenger plane at VCIA.
trophies.risk: Save before the attempt; the award is reported to be delayed until about 1 km away.

steps.text: Find a passenger plane attached to a boarding bridge at VCIA, such as gates E3/E4.
Enter the plane and reach the upstairs cockpit.
Back toward the runway and take off; planes parked away from the gates do not count.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport for the reported delayed unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and engage enemies.
trophies.risk: Free-roam attempt; preserve a save before entering the base.

steps.text: Save before approaching Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island.
Look for tanks in the air base's southern area.
Enter a military tank.
Engage enemies from the tank until the reported award appears.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use the silent back-door route.
trophies.risk: Detection fails the attempt; reload or retry rather than treating it as a permanent lockout.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to obtain the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's rear locked door; kicking it triggers the alarm.
Read the safe-code note and loot the safe without being detected.
Destroy security footage and disable the alarm in the back room before leaving.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Unlock large vault jobs, then rob five and escape.
trophies.risk: Post-story cleanup remains available; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Finish That's Where The Money Is… late in Chapter 4 to unlock large vault jobs.
Tail a security van and enter while the guard has the vault open.
Bring your partner for the cash bags and escape after looting five distinct vaults.
For 100%, finish all eight vaults within the 22 bank jobs; check drawers and safes as well.

disagree.note: Category difference: eight large vaults belong to 22 bank jobs. This trophy requires five vaults and escape.

versions.text: The bank guide lists eight large vaults.
The checklist requires 22 bank jobs; the specialist divides them into 14 small and eight large banks.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Use the Chapter 4 vault introduction route.
trophies.risk: Repeatable robbery cleanup; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Start That's Where The Money Is…, the optional Chapter 4 vault introduction.
Follow its armored security van to the bank.
Take the money; the roadmap reports a large vault robbery counts as the truck requirement.
Escape the wider red heat area for the reported award.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the remaining map fog.
trophies.risk: Free-roam exploration; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Review the map for regions still covered by black fog.
Fly over unexplored regions; a grid sweep helps reveal missed areas.
Recheck the map for remaining fog before another sweep.
Continue until all Leonida is explored, rather than stopping after a cross-state trip.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track gang ownership, not just robbery totals.
trophies.risk: Free-roam cleanup; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Review Progress > Gangs and approach illegal-operation markers.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.
Check gang ownership so repeated jobs from one gang do not hide a missing group.
Continue to all 39 operations for 100% completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Drink the reported cocktail at Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
trophies.risk: New method reported by PowerPyx and Game-Checklists; not personally gameplay-verified.

steps.text: Visit Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini, the drink named by both guides.
Drink it while standing beside the bar counter.
Use this exact bar and cocktail for the source-reported method; other drinks are not reported to count.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Use the blue showroom Banshee.
trophies.risk: Free-roam attempt; the reported popup can be delayed down the street.

steps.text: Obtain the Key Cloner through Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3.
Unlock the blue Bravado Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom.
Drive that car through the showroom window.
Continue down the street for the delayed award; the method specifies this blue Banshee.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Loot Kingpin Bowling's three key valuables.
trophies.risk: Reported repeatable; missed valuables can be collected when the operation respawns.

steps.text: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, collect the watch from the southeast office.
Collect the Gutterball shotgun from the northeast corner.
Open the northeast hallway-office safe with sticky bombs and take its contents.
Escape the police after looting all three valuables; return after respawn if anything was missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize both characters' Strength.
trophies.risk: Free-roam training; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, bring your partner to a fitness club.
Work out together; your partner trains alongside you.
Check each Strength bar in the Jason & Lucia menu.
Reach maximum Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

disagree.topic: Personal Best hidden status in published guides

versions.text: Push Square omits the hidden-trophy marker on Personal Best.
GTABase and Output Lag include it among the 28 hidden trophies.

disagree.note: The kit starter omits individual flags. We mark this hidden using the explicit lists, and preserve the differing marker report here.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Accumulate 500 Criminal Profile actions.
trophies.risk: No trophy missable reported; the roadmap warns that an Irredeemable profile is permanent.

steps.text: Enable Criminal Profile HUD notifications to see registered actions.
Accumulate profile changes through robberies, escapes and ordinary encounters.
Check the PS5 trophy counter until 500 profile actions are recorded.
Avoid forcing an Irredeemable profile solely for this trophy; no specific morality direction is required.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Research hold: no reliable trigger established.
trophies.risk: Trigger and missability unconfirmed; speculation is not an unlock method.

steps.text: Retain the official clue, “Second time's the charm,” without inferring a specific action.
Keep the trophy on research hold; checked guides do not establish a reproducible trigger.
Treat PowerPyx's Payday Loans idea as speculation rather than a verified route.
Preserve early manual saves as a precaution while the method remains unresolved.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Follow the source-reported night encounter.
trophies.risk: Random night encounter; no one-time lockout reported. Not personally gameplay-verified.

steps.text: Go alone northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 a.m.
Look for a blinking roadside car; leave and revisit if the random encounter is absent.
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light.
Speak to the returned woman, offer help and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Attempt the reported bike melee sequence.
trophies.risk: New method reported by PowerPyx; not personally gameplay-verified. No verified button sequence supplied.

steps.text: Ride a bike in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Stay on the bike for melee drive-by hits.
Kick ten pedestrians within 60 seconds for the source-reported method.
Check the PS5 award after that sequence; the sources do not supply a verified button combination.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Fence marked bills until cumulative income reaches $250,000.
trophies.risk: Free-roam accumulation; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to obtain the Dye Pack Jammer.
Collect marked bills from banks and payday-loan jobs.
Sell marked bills to contacts; the roadmap recommends Yasmani for payout.
Accumulate $250,000 actually laundered across deliveries, not merely cash stolen.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Reach $100,000 in cumulative purchases.
trophies.risk: Cumulative spending; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Buy shop items; weapons are one source-recommended spending option.
Include vehicle modifications and tattoos among eligible shop purchases.
Accumulate $100,000 in spending across visits.
Track money spent separately from laundering income; the listed objective is purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages through Vice City Real Estate.
trophies.risk: Purchases remain available for cleanup; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 and wait for the Vice City Real Estate app.
Budget the reported combined purchase cost of $160,000.
Buy all eight purchasable garages through the app; four story garages are separate.
Use the extra garage slots when registering vehicles for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through Moses.
trophies.risk: Free-roam registration; no missable condition reported.

steps.text: Finish Moses in Chapter 2 to unlock Scooter Bros access.
Keep free garage capacity for each additional registered vehicle.
Take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Repeat until ten vehicles are registered; scanning alone is not registration.
